name: @helpdesk/mdm-gateway
description: MDM gateway: MCP server, its own policy engine and audit chain, device reads only. Disjoint Graph permissions and certificate from the identity gateway (SPRINT2.md, Stage A).

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/identity-gateway build && vitest run
scripts.test:watch: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/identity-gateway build && vitest
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/identity-gateway build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @helpdesk/audit-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/gateway-core build && pnpm --filter @helpdesk/identity-gateway build && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
